commands.purpose: Read-only behavioural probe of the current attestation/publication surface (EXP-BASE-0..19); writes only under iso/scratch.
commands.argv: REPLACED IN r2 by argv_frozen_as + argv_as_recorded (see argv_discrepancy_note)
commands.argv_discrepancy_note: F-I08A-08: the frozen form used the interpreter placeholder plus a relative script name; the recorded run used absolute paths, because PowerShell's text-pipeline redirection re-encodes non-ASCII paths to UTF-16, so the child was launched from run_c3.py with file-handle redirection instead. Semantically equivalent (same interpreter, same flags, same script, same cwd); only the path form and the redirection channel differ. Both forms must reproduce the same observation invariants listed in review.md (I08A-c9); raw bytes are NOT expected to match because the probe generates fresh random test keys.
commands.runner: <attempt>/run_c3.py (host-side only; sets child cwd to <attempt>/iso, clears REVENUE_ATTESTATION_PROVIDER / REVENUE_TRUSTED_SIGNER_PUBLIC_KEYS / REVENUE_PUBLICATION_REGISTRY, sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1)
commands.expected_business_result: one EXP: JSON line per observation, no observation with status=ERROR, and the four gaps of oracle.md section 4 reproduced (A-D1 mechanism true, provider never invoked, receipt carries no signature domain, registry shows no signed history).
commands.raw_result: EXP-SUMMARY observations=35 errors=0 error_ids=[]; stderr 0 bytes

runs.cause: harness defect only: publication_registry._set_read_only chmods the scratch registry read-only after every append, so the probe's own `unlink(missing_ok=True)` of a leftover scratch registry raised PermissionError: [WinError 5] on Windows and aborted the run after EXP-BASE-17. All 29 observations recorded in that run are valid and agree with the final run.
runs.action: fixed the PROBE (reset_scratch_file clears the read-only bit for iso/scratch files only); no assertion, expectation or product claim was changed to accommodate the failure

runs.cause: harness defect only: PowerShell text-pipeline redirection re-encoded the child output, so paths containing the non-ASCII workspace segment were recorded as mojibake in the summary line
runs.action: switched to file-handle redirection in run_c3.py; observations themselves were unaffected

commands.purpose: Independent recomputation of the frozen signature rules: fingerprint = sha256(raw public key)[:32]; signed message = canonical_sha256(payload).encode('ascii') (64 chars); Ed25519 signature is 128 hex chars; a one-bit payload change invalidates the signature; the publication payload hash excludes result_sha256/publication_receipt; the receipt carries no signature domain.
Prove oracle.md / decision.md / commands.json were frozen before the first probe execution.
commands.expected_business_result: oracle.md and decision.md predate the first probe output

commands.purpose: Stability check for the reviewer: re-run the exact same probe against the unchanged isolated copy and compare the observation set, not the raw bytes.
commands.expected_business_result: same 35 observation ids, errors=0, the same two rows with gap=true (EXP-BASE-11, EXP-BASE-12), and no row with matches=false. Raw stdout is NOT expected to be byte-identical because the probe generates fresh random Ed25519 test keys each run, so EXP-BASE-9's fingerprint differs.
commands.evidence_path: after/c3_probe.stdout.txt (overwritten by the re-run) + iso/c9_compare.py output
commands.note: byte-level stdout sha256 changed (8bcb92b6... -> ecfa933d...) solely because EXP-BASE-9's random test-key fingerprint changed; every invariant row is identical. after/c3_probe.stdout.txt therefore holds the re-run, and the pre-rerun bytes are preserved in after/product_hashes.txt history and in this record.

commands.capability_limit: REVIEWER-MEASURED LIMIT: this check proves only that the SET of E-numbers is self-consistent (every used number is defined in decision.md section 2.5 and every defined number is referenced). It does NOT check the number-to-code-string pairing, so two mutations survive it: repointing a NEG row to a different E-number, and swapping two code strings inside section 2.5 itself. The reviewer measured both as undetected (PROBLEMS=0, rc=0) while an independent pair check found mismatches=2. The pair check is I08A-c13-check-r3-pairs.

commands.purpose: r3 independent PAIR check: build the canonical number->code-string map from decision.md section 2.5, then verify every other '**E##** `string`' reference in decision.md and every NEG row's fourth cell in oracle.md agrees with it. Self-tests by generating two mutated copies in iso/scratch/r3_mutations (repoint one row; swap two canonical strings) and asserting both are detected.
commands.expected_business_result: REAL pair_problems=0 AND both mutations detected
commands.raw_result: [REAL] canonical_pairs=32, pair_problems=0; [A_repoint_one_row] detected=True (1 mismatch); [B_swap_two_rows] detected=True (4 mismatches); PAIR_CHECK_RESULT=clean_and_both_mutations_detected
commands.note: this is the check that closes the reviewer-measured gap in I08A-c10. It validates frozen TEXT only, never the product implementation. Mutation copies are confined to iso/scratch and are not part of the frozen evidence chain.
